## What this changes

One paragraph. If the diff is bigger than the paragraph, the paragraph is wrong.

## Which tool

- [ ] `scanner/`
- [ ] `exploit-kit/`

## Evidence

For a verdict or chain change, paste the output that shows the new behaviour — a
test run, a lab log, or a `--diagnose` block. A claim about a target without
evidence will be asked for evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes (78 tests)
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] Behavioural and version evidence are still labelled separately
- [ ] No runtime dependencies added
- [ ] `FINDINGS.md` updated if a chain stage changed status, in either direction
- [ ] Docs updated if a flag, verdict or exit code changed
